fork_commits.subject: Rename project to ogedit and add comprehensive documentation
fork_commits.review: Renames Cargo package/binary, imports and CLI help/version to ogedit; adds developer documentation and dist ignore. The Cargo dependency lockfile is also refreshed.

fork_commits.subject: Add persistent Word Wrap configuration
fork_commits.review: Adds ~/.ogedit/state.json, word-wrap persistence, startup defaults, JSON parsing/serialization and corrupt-config backup. Word wrap itself is inherited from Edit.

fork_commits.subject: Update About dialog with OGEdit fork information
fork_commits.review: Updates About attribution AND introduces the duplicate-line/selection implementation, Edit > Duplicate and its English localization. The title understates the code change.

fork_commits.subject: Add Ctrl+D duplicate line feature with comprehensive tests
fork_commits.review: Adds the two-line Ctrl+D shortcut dispatch. Despite the subject/body, this diff contains no tests; the implementation had landed in 940f30b.

fork_commits.subject: Add comprehensive debug logging system
fork_commits.review: Adds per-session log files and instrumentation for input, search, menus, file operations, settings and cursor state. Logs include user text by default in the historical snapshot.

fork_commits.subject: Document debug logging system in CLAUDE.md
fork_commits.review: Adds a panic hook, startup/resize logging and documentation; this is not a documentation-only change.

fork_commits.subject: Fix Ctrl+D duplicate line crashes and improve behavior
fork_commits.review: Moves duplication into TextBuffer, fixes line/selection and wrap handling, adds cursor byte offsets; also logs selected content and whole-document idle snapshots.

fork_commits.subject: Expand configuration system with more settings and comments
fork_commits.review: Adds persistent indentation, tab size, newline, line numbers, current-line highlight, final-newline and ruler defaults; supports full-line // comments and saves status-bar changes.

fork_commits.subject: Add file modification tracking (Commit 1: timestamp detection)
fork_commits.review: Captures file mtimes on open/save/reload and exposes has_file_changed_on_disk; not yet a complete user-visible reload flow.

fork_commits.subject: Add status bar reload indicator and menu (Commit 2: UI integration)
fork_commits.review: Adds a changed-on-disk status button and reload popup. That particular status UI is removed in cb15dae and replaced by File-menu reload in 3bea69e.

fork_commits.subject: Update README for OGEdit fork and improve CI workflow
fork_commits.review: Rewrites README for the fork; adds macOS CI and optimized-build checks, cache fallback and removes formatting check; shortens the temporary reload status label.

fork_commits.subject: Fix edit:: to use imported CoordType
fork_commits.review: Fixes a remaining edit::helpers::CoordType reference in main after the crate rename.

fork_commits.subject: Fix edit:: to ogedit:: in benchmarks
fork_commits.review: Renames benchmark crate imports from edit to ogedit.

fork_commits.subject: Fix function pointer cast in Unix signal handler
fork_commits.review: Uses an intermediate pointer cast for the Unix signal handler to satisfy the function-cast lint.

fork_commits.subject: Use is_some_and instead of map_or(false, ...)
fork_commits.review: Replaces map_or(false, ...) with is_some_and in status-bar change detection; behavior-preserving lint cleanup.

fork_commits.subject: Release v1.2.2
fork_commits.review: Bumps to 1.2.2, adds five-target release ZIP/checksum workflow, removes upstream WinGet workflow and documents fork release/versioning.

fork_commits.subject: Add copyright notice for OGEdit fork
fork_commits.review: Adds the fork copyright line to LICENSE while retaining the Microsoft license.

fork_commits.subject: Add MSI installer support for Windows releases
fork_commits.review: Adds WiX MSI packages for Windows x64/ARM64, PATH integration, shortcuts, license and directory UI.

fork_commits.subject: Add per-project folder memory for Save As dialog
fork_commits.review: Persists last Save As directory keyed by launch working directory; chooses that directory on startup. Also introduces interim frame/time-based disk-check scheduling.

fork_commits.subject: Add recent files feature to Go to File dialog (Ctrl+P)
fork_commits.review: Adds up to 100 timestamped recent paths to Ctrl+P and Open, filters missing/open files, tracks startup/dialog opens, updates About maintainer. Also removes the earlier status reload popup and changes polling.

fork_commits.subject: Add reload dialog with confirmation for all scenarios
fork_commits.review: Adds File > Reload/F5 and dirty/external/both confirmation variants with localization, reload state and flags. Fixes idle snapshot logging marking documents clean by introducing read-only copy_content.

fork_commits.subject: Add file watcher for detecting external modifications
fork_commits.review: Adds background native watching (ReadDirectoryChangesW/inotify/kqueue) with timestamp fallback, register/unregister lifecycle and event handling in editor state.

fork_commits.subject: Fix file watcher and remove duplicate polling
fork_commits.review: Reworks Windows overlapped watcher lifetime/events, canonicalizes paths, joins worker on drop, adjusts Unix debounce and fallback polling; removes duplicate frame polling and renders function-key menu shortcuts.

fork_commits.subject: Add integration tests for file watcher
fork_commits.review: Adds native watcher integration tests and updates the lockfile. The OS-backed tests include timing/wait helpers.

fork_commits.subject: Fix crash when pasting over selection with word wrap enabled
fork_commits.review: Recomputes the safe cursor start after paste-over-selection with word wrap to avoid using visual positions from the old buffer.

fork_commits.subject: Add selection auto-highlight feature
fork_commits.review: Adds identical-selection occurrence highlighting, selection eligibility rules, generation/selection caching and a 1,000-match display cap.

fork_commits.subject: Restore cursor position after file reload
fork_commits.review: Restores cursor on reload using saved-line matching/nearest location; adds line extraction/matching helpers and updates visual statistics before setting the cursor.

fork_commits.subject: Add configurable keyboard shortcuts
fork_commits.review: Adds serialized configurable file/edit/view shortcuts, parser/defaults and menu/global dispatch; implements InputKey display formatting.

fork_commits.subject: Update documentation for configurable hotkeys
fork_commits.review: Documents shortcut names, keys, modifiers and customization examples; no product-code change.

fork_commits.subject: Suppress dead_code warning for safe_start field
fork_commits.review: Allows the now-unused EditInfo.safe_start field after the wrapped-edit fix; lint-only change.

fork_commits.subject: Fix clippy warnings
fork_commits.review: Lint-only parser/reload/watcher simplification (strip_prefix, direct returns, iteration).

fork_commits.subject: Fix clippy warnings
fork_commits.review: Completes watcher iteration lint fixes; no new feature.

fork_commits.subject: Actively check disk on F5 reload instead of relying only on watcher
fork_commits.review: F5 checks current disk metadata as well as the watcher cache before deciding which confirmation to show.

fork_commits.subject: Add documentation and comprehensive unit tests for new features
fork_commits.review: Adds settings/hotkey/history and buffer highlighting/line-helper tests, serial watcher CI step and docs. Also expands menu/dialog/clipboard logging.

fork_commits.subject: Add line number click selection feature
fork_commits.review: Adds line-number click, Shift+click and drag selection in the TUI, explicitly credited to Microsoft Edit PR #622 by jenia90; expands dialog logging.

fork_commits.subject: Add cross-platform installers and native archive formats
fork_commits.review: Adds macOS PKG/TAR.GZ and Linux DEB/RPM/AppImage/TAR archives plus checksums and release-note instructions.

fork_commits.subject: Fix YAML syntax error in CI workflow
fork_commits.review: Quotes the CI command containing watch:: to fix YAML parsing.

fork_commits.subject: Run flaky file watcher tests only on Linux
fork_commits.review: Temporarily limits native watcher integration tests to Linux because of Windows/macOS timing failures; superseded by 067ffe7.

fork_commits.subject: Fix macOS file watcher test failures
fork_commits.review: Deletes the kqueue filter before closing an unwatched descriptor, increases command-settling wait, and re-enables watcher tests on all platforms.

fork_commits.subject: Improve file watcher test reliability on Windows
fork_commits.review: Increases Windows watcher waits/retries and diagnostics, enables full backtraces; accidentally includes design notes, a shortcut and scratch test files.

fork_commits.subject: Remove accidentally committed test files
fork_commits.review: Removes the four accidental scratch files from 7fc67cf. They exist in history but not in the final fork delta.

fork_commits.subject: Release v1.2.3
fork_commits.review: Bumps Cargo.toml version to 1.2.3; no feature code changes.

fork_commits.subject: Release v1.2.4
fork_commits.review: Bumps Cargo.toml/lockfile to 1.2.4 and extracts appimagetool before building to avoid the CI FUSE requirement.

fork_commits.subject: Add auto-tagging workflow for releases
fork_commits.review: Adds Cargo-version auto-tag workflow and changes release version extraction to Cargo.toml. The historical GITHUB_TOKEN tag push does not trigger the release workflow.

fork_commits.subject: Handle race condition in auto-tag workflow
fork_commits.review: Adds auto-tag concurrency and treats all failed pushes as tag races, hiding real push failures; repaired during the legacy audit.

fork_commits.subject: Add optional EDITOR env var setting to installers
fork_commits.review: Adds opt-in EDITOR setup in MSI/PKG/DEB and the RPM helper, templates/scripts and release integration. Default remains off; audit found lifecycle/privilege issues in scripts.
